# Clavis Encrypt 3.10.1

## ✉️ Send with a password, now for encrypted files too

- Right-click a file you've already encrypted (`.enc`) → **Clavis → Send with a password…**. Clavis opens a private copy, locks it with a new one-time password under its real name (for example `Passport scan.pdf.enc`), and wipes the temporary copy. Your own `.enc` file stays exactly as it was.
- The person you send it to opens it at **clavisenc.com/open.html** on any phone or computer, or in Clavis Encrypt.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept. The right-click menu updates itself the first time the new version starts.
